items.note: States the eight-row schedule, the scratch-independent net change (JV+RG)x, the bit and complex central coefficients with side-wire cancellation, and the three-stage composition (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), exactly as in the proof at 741-765. The neighbour and wire counts (767-783) are not given, but they are bookkeeping rather than part of the lemma's argument.

Gives the invariant 'stored = frame applied to logical', the commutation of a shared frame with a pointwise gate by linearity, the operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, following 804-825.

The statement is complete and correct: nondegenerate labels in F^{(x)3}, orthogonal neighbouring triple lines, decreases only on central 3->4 edges each losing h, Wm-2N+2L, and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539. The derivation omits the actual label assignment: the stage transitions with A, B, P, Q (911-937) and the gate-label table eq:motif-labels (975-988). It therefore never shows why only central edges decrease (S1.3.4.4 just quotes it), and the 539 ratios are not computed from I, c, h, N.

Projections P_U at gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} at X_a sources, rank of P_V-P_U equal to dim V - dim U, the N exceptional 2P_{U_a} edges, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b with deficit N-2L_b, and the endpoint identity are all reproduced as in 1156-1172. Phi_M frames appear in S1.4.1.

The kernel factorization is derived faithfully: weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, odd-weight phases converted to aI+bX_v, and the count s_c with deficit 2N-2L_c (1231-1260). The other half of the proof, the endpoint telescoping to C^{(x)m}, is missing: zero label gives frame I, full label gives C^{(x)m}, and X_a->Y_a gives C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a), fixed by the Z corrections (1287-1314). S1.5.1.5 only quotes the outcome.

Covers L/N<1/2, the deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c, the exact relative deficits 339/22587335000000 and 73/19906842167500 (both above 20*2^{-50}), log m<20, and m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50}), giving s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, as at 1319-1346.

Both lemmas are stated correctly as infer steps: digit permutation and moves, split-apply-merge, cyclic row split, controlled shift y+a mod Q with b^{O(1)} offset, and rational units. S1.2 names the split at Q-a and the opposite-order merge, but there are no sub-steps (for example, the multiplication-by-unit construction is absent), so the item counts as stated, not derived.

Follows the reversed-Bruhat elimination (topmost row, rightmost pivot), the descending-order lower-triangular updates in O(V), and the three-step realisation of each one of Pi with one interchange, giving exactly a recursive calls (1375-1447). The choice of prime is stated a little loosely (see errors).

Reproduces the cyclic row split into W role streams of volume V/W, the Phi_M frames giving H<-H+D on every row, the D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D interchange, s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum in both cases a<=1 and a>1, and the parking-stack schedule, all as at 1491-1588.

Follows the high-digit row field of range at least W^k, padding of the row count by less than a factor 2, the base-m pieces summing to O(Ve^tau) via m^k<me, and padding [2^u] to [q^e], as in 1649-1734. The unequal-width variant (1740-1762) appears in S3.2.3 and S3.7.5.

Covers the edge product of directional kernels, conjugation by P_M using only invertibility, inverse children via (C^{-1})^{(x)f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, at most m(m-1)+3m row additions on whole slots, exactly s_c children, and H_0^{(x)D}=b^D S_D C^{(x)D} S_D, as in 1835-1940.

Eight controlled +-1 updates, whole-chunk cyclic shifts, guard interval 10<=g<=2^{K-1}-11, delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting B, radix-sort repair, and the normalized o(1) terms, all as in the proof. The S1.5.2 regime lists only two of the lemma's four family conditions (A_rect=O(p) and f<=d<=p are left implicit, though S1.5.2.6 uses them), so I judged it correct with that caveat.

Row index from the first q_0 chunks with padding, whole rows to roles, children of volume V/W, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves below d^{1/2}, internal sum O(e^lambda), leaves O(e^sigma d^{(1-sigma)/2}), and the base-m piece sum O(d^{lambda'}), following 2306-2448.

Character cancellation by index shift (no two-torsion), decimation in frequency with bit-reversed storage B_t F_t^- and the reverse F_t^+ B_t^{-1}, grouping a round as H then J_E, prefix moves O(TpdK), chunk exchanges O(Tp pK^{tau-1}), layer rounds O(Tp l d^{lambda'}), and the commutation J_E Q_p=Q_p J_E for one truncation per round, all faithful to 2819-3200.

Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four products with the established multiplier, the separation bound |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, centered extraction with carries in {0,1} including the sign extension, negacyclic reduction and truncation, as at 3233-3368.

Both identities are stated with their key content: the chirp with period t_i giving QF_t u=abar.(a*(abar.u))/T, and RF^+[(RF u)(RF v)]=(u*v)/S^2 through RF^+R=F^+. Conjugation for F^+ is in S3.9.3. These are infer steps without sub-steps; S3.4 sketches the mechanism, but the chirp coefficient computation is only quoted.

Fixed exponents, b, p=6b, d, K, T, r, axis lengths, eta=1/(4d) primes from the Rosser-Schoenfeld interval estimate, S/T>1/2, alpha^4 theta_i>3db>=p, and the n^{o(1)} prime search, all as at 4004-4179.

Isomorphism via the order of the image of x, the triangular digits b_i=a_i+mu_i sum_{j<i} a_j P_j, updates in order i=d..1 keeping zero padding, prefix-controlled shifts, and axis reordering at cost O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)), following 4216-4292.

Correctly states the twist x_d->zeta y with the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j and M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T as a bilinear contraction. These are infer steps; the computed-twist error (<4 each) belongs to the derivation and is not mentioned here.

The source transform (A tilde, chirp transform through twist and M_r, B_0 tilde, scale 2^gamma, exact counterpart RF_s) and the six-step algorithm with the two S scalings follow 4415-4544. The input scaling of the digits by 2^{-b-2} (4495-4498) is never stated, although the compensating 2^{2b+4} is.
Chains E_ring<5TL with the 0.701 margin, chirp <8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, E_w<28*2^gamma T^2 L, the final 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2 using gamma<=b/4, and carry propagation, as in 4546-4806.

Correct margins g_1..g_7 with min 2^{-181}=2kappa, o(V) setup and exceptional sorting, absorption of log p powers, and the schoolbook cutoff. Of the table's normalized costs, only the chunk-exchange row pK^{tau-1} is derived. The other rows (for example alpha=Theta(p^{1/4+eps/2}) for the Gaussian row, or log(rp)=O(p^{1-eps})) are never converted into their powers of p, and the cost table is not reproduced in S4.
S5 correctly states that T_A/(n lg n)=O((lg n)^{-kappa})->0, so no c_A, N_A exist, which is the negation described at 379-387.

errors.says: Every nonzero edge residual contains a vector of norm one, 'so it is nondegenerate and nonalternating' and therefore has an orthonormal basis.
errors.paper: Nondegeneracy of each residual comes from the orthogonal decompositions ('Each residual is nondegenerate by the decompositions above'); the norm-one vector gives only nonalternation. A space containing a norm-one vector can still be degenerate.

errors.says: q is 'a fixed odd prime avoiding all denominators'.
errors.paper: The prime must also avoid every numerator of a diagonal entry of an invertible triangular factor, so that the factors remain invertible modulo q^b.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route throughout. The scratch-restoring networks, frames, labels and ranks give s<Wm and s/W<m^tau. The interchange recurrence leads to the arbitrary-width swap; the phase-frame recursion and packed additions lead to the simultaneous layer. Synthetic transforms and signed packing give the ring convolution, and CRT, resampling, chirp, twist and exact recovery reach the cost table and O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). The tree thins in three places: the label construction (the gate-label table is never given, so the 'only central 3->4 edges decrease' claim is quoted rather than shown), the endpoint telescoping to C^{(x)m} in the complex interface, and the per-row powers of p in the final cost table.

steps.note: The plan has the fixed linear network on three-element subsets of [100], the exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and restoration of every auxiliary wire, with the eight-row mechanism. N=binom(100,3)^3 and the indexing a in T^3 are never written out; m is only implicit, as the dimension of F^{(x)3} with F=Q^{100}.
A common frame commutes with the pointwise gate, the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the intermediate frames are free so that edges are cheap.
Nondegenerate labels in F^{(x)3} of dimension m, comparable labels on every edge, and only the central 3->4 edges decreasing, each by h, are all stated. The label table itself is not given.
P_V-P_U has rank dim V - dim U, and the N source edges 2P_{U_a} are the rank-one exceptions.
Gives the sum Wm-2N+2L by telescoping, L as h times the number of central wires (that is, Ich), and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L/N=100/539 and 101/539, both below 1/2, with deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0, so s<Wm.
The endpoint difference is I_m on every role (P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a} on X_a), and the Phi_M frames give H<-H+D on every row, scratch rows included.
A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and s recursive calls per node.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), deficits above 20*2^{-50} with log m<20 giving s/W<m^tau for tau=1-2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the whole central chain, from the scratch-restoring exchange network through frames, nested labels, rank equal to dimension change, the budget Wm-2N+2L with an N-term correction, L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity, rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence to e^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}. Its only thin spots are that N=binom(100,3)^3 and the triple indexing are left implicit, and the label table is asserted rather than displayed.
